prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case in Atlanta — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, your injuries, your goals (quick settlement vs. trial), and how well you communicate with the attorney. I can help you find a lawyer who’s best for your specific situation. Meanwhile, here’s a practical guide to pick one quickly and safely.

Key criteria to use when choosing
- Specific experience with car-accident cases (not just “personal injury” generally).  
- Trial experience and a record of negotiated settlements and verdicts.  
- Local knowledge of Atlanta courts, medical providers, and insurers.  
- Clear fee structure (most work on contingency — commonly ~33% to 40% of recovery).  
- Willingness to advance case costs (medical records, expert fees) and explain who repays them.  
- Responsiveness and communication style that fits you.  
- Good client reviews and no recent disciplinary actions (check State Bar).

How to find and vet attorneys
- Use: State Bar of Georgia (verify license/discipline), Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo, Google reviews, and local referrals.  
- Look for law firms that focus on car-accidents and catastrophic injury.  
- Read client reviews and look for reported settlements/verdicts.  
- Call for a free consult — most Atlanta PI attorneys offer one.

Questions to ask in a consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine? Outcome examples (without breaching confidentiality)?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (attorney or paralegal)?  
- What is your fee and how do you handle costs?  
- What is your estimate of value and timeline for my case?  
- Do you have references from former clients?

Immediate steps you should take now
- Seek medical care and keep records.  
- Take photos of the scene, vehicles, injuries, and contact info for witnesses.  
- Preserve police report and any dashcam/phone footage.  
- Don’t give recorded statements to the other insurance company or sign releases without an attorney.  
- Be aware Georgia’s statute of limitations for personal injury is typically 2 years from the date of the crash — act promptly.

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated Atlanta car-accident lawyers and recent client reviews if you tell me your ZIP or neighborhood.  
- Draft a short list of questions to ask in a consultation.  
- Help you compare 2–3 attorneys you’re considering.

Which would you like me to do next?
